title: Jeopardy Thinking Music
blurb: The Jeopardy thinking music — thirty seconds of pleasant pressure, the world's most famous waiting song. Hum it at anyone taking too long to decide anything and they will feel the clock in their bones. Perfect for edits of slow decisions, loading screens, and friends choosing a restaurant. The doo-doo-doo of accountability.
origin: The 'Think!' music from Jeopardy's final round.
